claims.content: Allow users to adapt PeaZip’s features to their needs and preferences by configuring application settings, achieving a more pleasant and efficient use.

goal.raw_text: Allow users to adapt PeaZip’s features to their needs and preferences by configuring application settings, achieving a more pleasant and efficient use.

claims.content: User
PeaZip application is running.
User is on the initial window of the application (file manager interface).
User presses the 'Options' button on the initial window of the application (file manager interface).

trigger.raw_text: User presses the 'Options' button on the initial window of the application (file manager interface).

claims.content: A submenu appears with choices related to settings of parameters of PeaZip's features.
User selects 'Settings' from the submenu, which leads to the Settings window (Settings Interface).
In the Settings Interface, users are able to change application's language, choosing from a list of supported by PeaZip languages.
Users define the path for the location of the computer system that is going to be considered by PeaZip as user's Desktop.
Users choose the way backend command-line applications (featured by PeaZip) will run: console interface, graphical interface or combination of both.
Users set policy about PeaLauncher window's behavior after some function's termination.
Users have access to options related to character encoding.
Users have choices on recently managed archives history utility.
Users chose a selection of users' favorite archiving and compression formats to be offered for quick selection and which format should be used as default in create archive interface.
Users configure parameters of the features of archive creation and archive content extraction.
Users choose applications for opening/previewing contents of managed by PeaZip archives.
Users configure parameters of computer system's files and archives management tools.
Users adapt the application's graphical interface to their needs, modifying color, icons, fonts, window opacity and size for GUI, and toolbar buttons.
User selects 'Run as different user' from the submenu, which closes current PeaZip instance and opens a new one under alternative user profile.
User selects 'Localization' from the submenu, which quickly changes application's language (the new selection can be made from a list of supported by PeaZip languages).
The application's language is changed to the user's selection from the list of supported by PeaZip languages.
The path for the location considered by PeaZip as the user's Desktop is defined.
The way backend command-line applications will run (console interface, graphical interface or combination of both) is chosen.
The policy about PeaLauncher window's behavior after some function's termination is set.
Options related to character encoding are configured.
Choices on recently managed archives history utility are set.
A selection of users' favorite archiving and compression formats is chosen for quick selection and a default format is set for the create archive interface.
Parameters of the features of archive creation and archive content extraction are configured.
Applications for opening/previewing contents of managed by PeaZip archives are chosen.
Parameters of computer system's files and archives management tools are configured.
The application's graphical interface is adapted to the user's needs, including modifications to color, icons, fonts, window opacity and size for GUI, and toolbar buttons.
